context.title: Haight Ashbury Neighborhood Council: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: Haight Ashbury Neighborhood Council signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Haight Ashbury Neighborhood Council signed the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition D in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
